camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeRefreshTasks --region cn-hangzhou --Status Complete --ObjectType file --ObjectPath 'http://example.com/1.txt' --TaskId 1234321 --PageSize 20 --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmyuji4b6r400' --PageNumber 1 --DomainName 'example.com' --StartTime '2017-12-21T08:00:00Z'
description_en: Queries whether refresh or prefetch tasks have taken effect across the entire network
description_zh: 调用DescribeRefreshTasks查询刷新、预热状态是否在全网生效
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-refresh-tasks --task-id 1234321 --object-path http://example.com/1.txt --page-number 1 --object-type file --domain-name example.com --status Complete --page-size 20 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --resource-group-id rg-acfmyuji4b6r400 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRefreshTasks

parameters.help_en: The task ID used to query the refresh status
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The path used to query. Exact match is used
parameters.name: object_path

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.help_zh: 取得第几页，取值范围为：1~100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The task type. Valid values:
file: file refresh.
directory: directory refresh.
regex: regular expression-based refresh.
preload: file prefetch.
block: URL blocking.
unblock: URL unblocking.

When you specify DomainName or Status, ObjectType is required
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。取值：
file：文件刷新。
directory：目录刷新。
regex：正则刷新。
preload：文件预热。
block：URL封禁。
unblock：URL解封禁。

当指定DomainName或Status参数时，ObjectType参数为必传参数
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. Only a single domain name can be specified. By default, all accelerated domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名。仅支持单个查询，默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Complete: completed.
Refreshing: in progress.
Timeout: timed out.
Canceled: canceled.
Failed: failed
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值：

Complete：完成。
Refreshing：处理中。
Timeout：超时未执行。
Canceled：取消。
Failed：失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认20，最大100。取值：1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
